ingredients.name: Gotu kola (pennywort) or parsley/spinach/rocket
ingredients.notes: large bunch, leaves and part of stems finely chopped

ingredients.name: Fresh grated coconut or desiccated coconut (unsweetened)

steps.instruction: Wash gotu kola and pat dry. Finely chop the leaves and partway down the stems, discarding the thick lower stems. Place in a large mixing bowl.
Add the finely chopped red onion, roughly chopped cherry tomatoes and green chilli to the bowl.
Sprinkle over the coconut and using your hands mix all ingredients together well.
Add lime juice and salt, mix again, and let the sambol rest for a few minutes before serving alongside your favourite curries.

notes: Gotu kola (Centella asiatica / pennywort) is a medicinal herb widely used in Sri Lankan cooking. Substitute with parsley if unavailable. Recipe by Ranji Thangiah (Tooting Mama). Can be served as a side salad or condiment.
